notes.title: 27 New Instructions is Out
notes.content:
[b]Change log:[/b]

New instructions allow more efficient use of memory. Less code more productivity. See list of new instructions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2179558849]HERE[/url]. 

Now there is no need to manually write the NOP-instruction in the ASM Mode. You can just press ENTER on a blank line and the instructions will be filled in automatically.

Added Discord support.

Fixed bug found by user. (Thank you Vincent!)
